question: Who owns the current hybrid standard, and who can approve an exception?

response.answer: People Operations owns the current Hybrid Work Standard 2026, approved and effective February 1, 2026. The department head approves exceptions to its three-office-days-per-week schedule for employees eligible for hybrid work. [F01] The 2024 standard is superseded; the 2027 draft is unapproved. [F02][F03]
